files.purpose: Publishes, in section 4, the completeness-result/truth-independence rule, the ascending scope2/coverage2 selection order, the six-step outgoing cause derivation with each cause's universe and the exact refs each return carries, the incoming derivation and its absence of any early return, and the deterministic DEPENDS_ON view with the coverage-unknown carrier rule. Makes existing behaviour explicit; adds no cause token and no public field.

Minimal reference correction: _coverages_exact and _scopes_exact return their selections in ascending identifier order instead of host map order, so the first-wins folds downstream (_conservative_entry's typed carrier, run_suff's nativeCause scan) read a deterministic logical input. Two return statements plus docstrings; no other behaviour change.

Six reference controls for the publication boundary, deterministic cause/field selection, early-stop scope, known-hit dominance and shared incoming/dependency behaviour, exercising the actually selected atom owner.
